title: Live nametags
description: Live tiers from PvPTiers, PvPHQ, SubTiers and NovaTiers on ranked players' nametags. Each enabled site shows its best placement.

title: Four sites on one nametag
description: One nametag with a placement from each site. The icon shows the gamemode and the color shows the site.

title: Lookup screen
description: /justtiers lookup shows every gamemode on every site next to the player's skin. A dash means no placement was reported.

title: Settings screen
description: Turn sites on or off, move the badge and pick colors. The preview uses example tiers and sends no request.
